text: Tenant's First is an ambitious program approved by City Council originating from the Mayor's Task force on Toronto Community Housing Corporation. Staff have undertaken a number of very complicated pieces of work with great success, most recently the transfer of the staff and tenants from Toronto Community Housing Corporation to Toronto Seniors Corporation. After a year's work to prepare for the transfer there remain a few pieces of legal and financial matters still be completed. It turned out that due to legal and financial matters that Toronto Community Housing Corporation will continue to own the buildings and be responsible for all major capital while the new Toronto Seniors Housing Corporation will look after day to day operations and repairs and use the IT and other Toronto Community Housing Corporation programs to run the new corporation.
